ud1.9:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Gayāyaṃ viharati Gayāsīse.
ud1.9:1.3: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā jaṭilā sītāsu hemantikāsu rattīsu antaraṭṭhake himapātasamaye Gayāyaṃ ummujjanti pi nimujjanti pi ummujjanimujjaṃ pi karonti osiñcanti pi aggiṃ pi juhanti,
ud1.9:2.1: addasā kho bhagavā te sambahule jaṭile sītāsu hemantikāsu rattīsu antaraṭṭhake himapātasamaye Gayāyaṃ ummujjante pi nimujjante pi ummujjanimujjaṃ karonte pi osiñcante pi aggiṃ pi juhante
ud1.9:3.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
